scripts.app: npm run app:build && npm run app:serve
scripts.app:install: podman run --rm -v $PWD:/app:Z -w /app $SW_NODE_IMAGE sh -c 'npm i -g pnpm@10 >/dev/null 2>&1 && pnpm install'
scripts.app:build: podman run --rm -v $PWD:/app:Z -w /app ${SW_NODE_IMAGE:-docker.io/library/node:24-bookworm-slim} sh -c 'npm i -g pnpm@10 >/dev/null 2>&1 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && pnpm exec vite build'
scripts.app:serve: podman rm -f sw-serve 2>/dev/null; podman run -d --network host -e PORT=3000 --name sw-serve -v $PWD:/app:Z -w /app ${SW_NODE_IMAGE:-docker.io/library/node:24-bookworm-slim} node serve.mjs && echo 'app on http://localhost:3000'
scripts.shot: mkdir -p /tmp/sw-shots && chmod 777 /tmp/sw-shots && rm -f /tmp/sw-shots/*.png && podman run --rm --network host -v $PWD/tools/shot.mjs:/home/pptruser/shot.mjs:ro,Z -v $PDF:/in.pdf:ro,Z -v /tmp/sw-shots:/shots:Z -e PDF=/in.pdf -w /home/pptruser ghcr.io/puppeteer/puppeteer:latest node shot.mjs
